from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u056/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    height, width = bottom - top - 1, right - left - 1
    colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            depth = min(r - top - 1, bottom - 1 - r, c - left - 1, right - 1 - c)
            # Keep the single central cell of an odd-sized interior unchanged.
            if height % 2 and width % 2 and r == (top + bottom) // 2 and c == (left + right) // 2:
                continue
            out[r][c] = colors[depth % len(colors)]
    return out
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-0f8da700.py'
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'))
# Reconstruct each demonstrated hollow square from its size and location.
def frame_grid(n, size, top, left):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    b=top+size-1; rr=left+size-1
    for c in range(left,rr+1): g[top][c]=g[b][c]=5
    for r in range(top,b+1): g[r][left]=g[r][rr]=5
    return g
for n,size,top,left,interior in [(13,9,1,1,7),(6,6,0,0,4),(16,12,1,3,10),(19,17,1,1,15)]:
    out=transform(frame_grid(n,size,top,left))
    got=sorted({out[r][c] for r in range(top+1,top+size-1) for c in range(left+1,left+size-1)})
    print(n, size, got, 'center', out[top+size//2][left+size//2])
# Test grid, same 30x30 frame at rows/cols 1..25 as shown.
test=frame_grid(30,25,1,1)
answer=transform(test)
print('answer dims',len(answer),len(answer[0]))
print(answer)
